These are six NOAA NEXRAD Level III samples distributed with Unidata MetPy
v1.7.1. They exercise the product decoders used here; the upstream sample
paths and SHA-256 digests are recorded below.

| Product | Upstream sample |
| --- | --- |
| Base reflectivity (94) | `KOUN_SDUS54_N0QTLX_201305202016` |
| Storm-relative velocity (56) | `KOUN_SDUS54_N0STLX_201305202016` |
| Base radial velocity (99) | `KOUN_SDUS54_N0UTLX_201305202016` |
| Correlation coefficient (161) | `KOUN_SDUS84_N0CTLX_201305202016` |
| Differential reflectivity (159) | `KOUN_SDUS84_N0XTLX_201305202016` |
| Specific differential phase (163) | `KOUN_SDUS84_N0KTLX_201305202016` |

Source directory: <https://github.com/Unidata/MetPy/tree/v1.7.1/staticdata/nids>

The samples are public NOAA weather data. MetPy's decoder is BSD-3-Clause;
these binary samples remain attributable to NOAA/NWS.
